title: Common Ground nonprofit coffee website redesign — visible-content checks
instructions: Read brief.md, then redesign all eight supplied HTML fragments into one cohesive responsive nonprofit coffee marketing site. Preserve the protected assembly/behavior contracts. Implement real edits and finish only after your assigned work is complete. The full task passes only when all automated browser checks pass; visual design is reviewed separately. Headline and both hero calls to action must be genuinely visible at mobile and desktop sizes. Decorative overlays must not cover them; an element being present in the DOM is insufficient.

workers.name: Header designer
workers.brief: Build the brand header and responsive semantic navigation linking menu, mission, events and visit. Scope CSS to #top. Follow brief.md for palette, IDs and accessibility.

workers.name: Hero designer
workers.brief: Create a compelling editorial hero with a large h1, a coffee visual using CSS or inline SVG, and menu/mission calls to action. Scope CSS to #hero. Follow brief.md.

workers.name: Mission designer
workers.brief: Design a persuasive nonprofit mission section, explicitly including 100% of surplus funding job training. Scope CSS to #mission. Follow brief.md.

workers.name: Menu designer
workers.brief: Design responsive drink cards and accessible search. Preserve protected script selectors, all supplied names/prices and the no-results message. Scope CSS to #menu. Follow brief.md.

workers.name: Impact designer
workers.brief: Design a responsive annual-impact stats section: 2,500 meals, 120 training hours, 35 graduates, with meaningful labels. Scope CSS to #impact. Follow brief.md.

workers.name: Events designer
workers.brief: Design three dated event cards using the supplied names/dates, semantic h3/time markup and newsletter signup links. Scope CSS to #events. Follow brief.md.

workers.name: Visit designer
workers.brief: Design the visit section with semantic address, supplied location and opening hours, and an optional CSS/inline-SVG location visual. Scope CSS to #visit. Follow brief.md.

workers.name: Newsletter designer
workers.brief: Design accessible newsletter signup and footer. Preserve all form/input/status IDs and attributes for protected behavior. Scope CSS to #newsletter and footer. Follow brief.md.

success_definition: All browser checks pass at 390px and 1440px, including visible rendered-pixel contribution from the hero headline and both hero CTAs. No scripts or external assets. Visual aesthetics are separately reviewed, not certified by tests.
notes: Validation lives outside the model-editable workspace. A model cannot change expected answers or tests.
version_note: Version2 adds occlusion checks after v1 accepted an opaque pointer-events:none overlay covering the hero. Fixture starts from the same plain sections; v1 is retained unchanged.
